component: ZenDB v2.0.1 M1 synthetic authoritative-data proof
status: SUPERSEDED REMOTE-TOPOLOGY DIAGNOSTIC 2026-09-22: the former revoke-only upgrade test was removed. The local-only synthetic runner now tests controller handoff from A to B: A installs the digest/length-bound artifact, creates bounded data, revokes A's bootstrap role, and makes B sole controller; B performs the exact upgrade, proves its intended admin capability, and A is denied grant read, write, and self-regrant. runner.network: fresh project-local ephemeral loopback DFX local network
runner.networkBoundary: The corrected runner configures local as 127.0.0.1:0, pings it before creation, uses --network local for every DFX operation, creates with --no-wallet, and uses an isolated disposable DFX config for replica lifecycle plus DFX's built-in anonymous identity for every ingress-capable command. It therefore selects no developer PEM/keyring, wallet, or signing authority. Ingress/lifecycle operations are bounded to 180 seconds and exact O3 builds to 360 seconds, each with a 10-second kill grace and cleanup trap. It does not invoke mops install because Mops 2.19.2 makes an unrelated compatibility request before resolving the pinned lock.

runner.upgradeArtifact: the exact pinned src/RemoteInstance/CanisterDB/lib.mo compiled as zendb-canister with matching default persistence flags
